method: Independent read-only visual inspection of the three final native city captures and their dimensions/hashes. No Godot or browser process was run by this reviewer.
result: No blocking city-scene visual defect found within the reviewed captures.
observations: The developed and mixed scenes show distinguishable silhouettes for the 16 canonical building types; no neighboring atlas sprite fragment or opaque dark background rectangle is visible.
Buildings remain within their own surveyed parcels. Their proportions look consistent with the source art; roofs, walls and shadows do not obscure adjacent site numbers or labels.
Desktop six-column and phone three-column layouts retain visible sites 01 through 36, including the final empty parcels 34 through 36.

Phone name/level strips and site numbers are readable. The mixed phone image shows site 01 house at level 0 as a bare foundation with a 59-second queue badge, and site 18 house at completed level 3 with upgrade scaffolding and a 29-second queue badge.

Displayed reserved sites 16, 21 and 22 remain courtyards; displayed site 15 remains the hall. Fresh-phone hall level 1 and developed/mixed hall level 10 visibly use different completed-tier appearances.

The widened main street aligns with the south gate in both column layouts. Northern and southern wall spans remain outside the building grid; the southern wall/gate does not cover parcels 34 through 36.
The ground and streets read as a common earth surface; stronger building label strips preserve readability without neighboring building overlap.
nonBlockingPolish: Repeated northern and southern wall segment seams are still visible at native scale.
The full fresh city retains a strong surveyed-grid/planning-map appearance through straight streets and uniform empty parcels; this is compatible with this iteration's explicit readable-grid goal.
The straight side walls have less material detail than the building sprites and the horizontal wall/gate art.
scopeLimits: The phone images are 390-by-2064 full-content captures, not a 390-by-844 application viewport. They do not verify real viewport scrolling, fixed HUD visibility, hall-focus scrolling or touch behavior.
No final Web capture was supplied for this review.

construction-panel-phone-compare.png is explicitly excluded: the parent reported its quote footer was not yet final and was being repaired. No final construction-panel or sticky-quote certification is made here.
